candidates.name: hidradenocarcinoma
support_spans: Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement. Tumor cells diffusely dispersed between collagen bundles and lined up in an 'Indian file pattern' with basophilic nuclei and scant cytoplasm.
Positive for: pancytokeratin (AE1/AE3), cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies
candidates.why: The histopathological description and immunohistochemistry results are consistent with hidradenocarcinoma, a rare sweat gland malignancy.

candidates.name: apocrine gland carcinoma
support_spans: Multiple GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration
candidates.why: The presence of apocrine glands and the specific immunohistochemical profile support the diagnosis of apocrine gland carcinoma.

candidates.name: extramammary Paget disease
support_spans: erythematous plaque in the right axilla measuring 5 × 3 cm
Positive for: pancytokeratin (AE1/AE3), cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies
candidates.why: The clinical presentation and immunohistochemical findings are also consistent with extramammary Paget disease, a rare skin malignancy.
